prompt: Show a client checking API health through a gateway and health service with status returned.
enzo:
sequence ApiHealthCheck
actor Client
participant Gateway
participant HealthApi
participant Database
Client -> Gateway: GET /health
Gateway -> HealthApi: Check health
HealthApi -> Database: Ping dependency
Database --> HealthApi: Ping ok
HealthApi --> Gateway: Healthy
Gateway --> Client: 200 OK
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
actor Client
participant Gateway
participant HealthApi
participant Database
Client->>Gateway: GET /health
Gateway->>HealthApi: Check health
HealthApi->>Database: Ping dependency
Database-->>HealthApi: Ping ok
HealthApi-->>Gateway: Healthy
Gateway-->>Client: 200 OK
